text: Teaching Objectives This program will enable you to be qualified personnel with advanced technology and engineering knowledge of safety & environmental science and related disciplines. It will help you to develop all-round morality, intellectuality and physical fitness in order to meet the needs of modern industrial development. Main Courses Engineering of Safety System, Risk Assessment, Environmental Monitoring Technology, Air pollution Control Engineering, Information Technology of Safety Engineering, Water Treatment Engineering, Environment Quality Appraisement, Safety monitoring, Solid Waste Treatment Engineering, Elementary Chinese (Oral Chinese, Intensive Chinese & Extensive Chinese), A Survey of China, Advanced Math, Physics, Fundamental Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry. Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded Master Degree of Engineering. Career After graduation, you will be capable of working in the fields of design, research, monitoring, evaluation, supervising and management related with safety and environmental engineering.
